method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, proof reverse paraphrase, exact formula, macro, token and identifier comparison; the release audit found and repaired one previously untranslated explanatory sentence; no independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Identity rules in the sequent calculus: identity initial sequents, equality substitution, Leibniz-style substitutability, symmetry and transitivity, and two requested derivations.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Identity derivations require extra initial sequents and inference rules. Every closed term t gives an identity initial sequent with t on both sides. The equality rule permits replacing a closed term in a formula on the right in either direction, with t1 and t2 closed.
samples.checks: The derivation and identity tokens, equality symbol, closed-term condition, initial-sequent definition, rule heading and both displayed rule directions remain exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For closed terms s and t, equality of s and t together with A(s) derives A(t) by weakening the initial A(s) sequent and applying the equality rule. This is the substitutability-of-identicals or Leibniz-law principle.
samples.checks: The Proves formula, proof tree, weakening rule, equality rule and the explanatory principle are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: LK proves equality symmetric and transitive. The first proof uses the reflexive initial sequent, weakening and equality; the second chains two equalities and exchanges the left context. The final note identifies the formula instantiations used in each proof.
samples.checks: Both proof trees, rule labels, context order, exchange step, formula instantiations and LK claim remain unchanged.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The exercise asks for derivations of a universal implication expressing equality substitution and of the existence-and-uniqueness characterization of an A-object.
samples.checks: Both exercise formulas, quantifier nesting, conjunctions, conditionals, equality occurrences and the derivation token are retained exactly.
